pieces.Text: You can assume the appearance of a specific humanoid as per minor metamorphosis, but without any extra abilities.  The uncomfortable transformation takes 5 rounds to complete, during which you are staggered.  If you study your victim for 3 rounds, you recieve a bonus of +
on Bluff checks to impersonate that individual, a +

bonus on Disguise checks, and a +1 bonus on Use Magic Device rolls to emulate the humanoid's race.  Ending the transfomration can be done as a free action, but takes 5 rounds to complete, during which time you are staggered.  You cannot be under the effect of this talent and Undistinguished Features at the same time.
